corpus.name: product-handbook.txt
corpus.text: Northstar notebooks have a 30-day return window. Items must be unused and include the original packaging. Support replies within two business days.

corpus.name: shipping-guide.txt
corpus.text: Standard shipping takes three to five business days. Express shipping takes one business day and is available for domestic orders.

corpus.name: security-note.txt
corpus.text: The demo never stores provider keys. Uploaded files are limited by size and kept only in memory. Retrieved text is treated as untrusted evidence.
